messages.author: 6fd1fccedadfe847
messages.subject: Unbending in Geomorph
parts:
Hi,
I used tpsUtil to unbend Salamander larvae but many resulted R^2<<0.9, which as I understand cannot be used to for unbending specimens since the regression curve doesn't represent my reference curve properly. So I read Valentin et. al. 2008, but I'm not sure I fully understand how to apply their method. Did anyone write a code in R/goemorph to unbend specimens using this method and can share it?
Thanks,
Avi

messages.author: 8d946a503948c03a
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Unbending in Geomorph
parts:
Hi Avi,

From Julien Claude's "Morphometrics with R" p. 115 you can find an example R code to apply Burnaby's method which - if I remember correctly - is the one described in Valentin et al. 2008. 

Hope this helps.

Best
Antoine
